title: Account and settings, clearly grouped
summary: Personal profile, device appearance, app help and sign-in security now have a clearer place in the account sheet.
changes: Account now groups personal details, appearance, app help and passkeys in a calmer sheet, with a centred dialog on larger screens.
The approved account identity is distinct from preferred profile details and the locally highlighted roster name.
Photo, profile and passkey controls have clearer spacing, touch targets and saving feedback.
Profile privacy, password access, shared roster identity and deliberate PWA update approval remain unchanged.
